edition.description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

rows.translation: Have you seen the one who denies the Recompense?
Such is the one who repulses the orphan harshly,
and does not urge others to feed the needy.
So woe to those who pray,
but are heedless of their prayer[1];
rows.footnotes: [1] i.e., the hypocrites who do not pray except to show off and others who are heedless to pray at their specified times.

rows.translation: and withhold even the small kindnesses.
